literal: The two men's weight of power was on a par with Yin.
idiomatic: The two men's authority weighed as heavily as Yin's.

literal: When Yin met his death, Xing Zicai wept and said: "Magistrate Yang was indeed such a man; at the day of death one regrets he could not have one worthy companion.
idiomatic: When Yin was killed, Xing Zicai wept and said, "Lord Yang was truly such a man — on the day of his death, how one wished he had a worthy companion at his side.

literal: " Later Yi was by the same edict as Yin posthumously granted Director within the Palace and Inspector of Guangzhou.
idiomatic: " Later, by the same edict as Yin, Yi was posthumously made palace secretary and inspector of Guangzhou.

literal: Yi's younger brother Kang, style Zixin, had considerable accomplishment in letters.
idiomatic: Yi's younger brother Kang, styled Zixin, was well versed in letters.

literal: At the end of Wuping, he concurrently served as Left and Right Langzhong, awaiting summons at the Forest of Literary Excellence.
idiomatic: At the end of Wuping he served concurrently as left and right langzhong, awaiting summons at the Forest of Literary Excellence.

literal: The complete text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
idiomatic: The full text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972.
